library_preparation_preflight.summary: H2GIS is embedded and its published dependencies already provide H2, h2gis-api, h2gis-utilities, JTS, and related libraries; no extra dependency or Docker image is needed. Spatial coverage requires explicit extension initialization. [Maven Central](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/org.orbisgis/h2gis)
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Use an in-memory H2 JDBC connection and call org.h2gis.ext.H2GISExtension.load(connection) before spatial DDL or SQL functions. The documented alternative is the H2GIS_SPATIAL alias followed by CALL H2GIS_SPATIAL(). Exercise public spatial SQL/JDBC APIs, keep tests version-agnostic, and avoid filesystem/network drivers for baseline coverage. [Embedded database guide](https://h2gis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/embedded-spatial-db.html)
risks: Extension loading registers spatial types and functions; Native Image metadata may be required, so local native verification remains authoritative.

library_preparation_preflight.summary: org.orbisgis:h2gis is a pure-JVM, in-memory library (H2 + JTS + CTS pulled transitively via the single h2gis coordinate already in build.gradle). No GDAL/raster support, no Docker service, and no env/system-property is required to reach the missing reflective calls (ST_GeomFromGeoJSON, ST_AsGeoJSON, ST_SetSRID, FindGeometryMetadata, ST_DWithin, ST_Intersects, ST_Within, ST_DistanceSphere) — they're all in the org.h2gis.functions.** package already covered by user-code-filter.json.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: The existing H2gisTest already calls ST_GeomFromGeoJSON and ST_Intersects with literal SQL arguments, which the agent apparently already captures. The issue reporter's failure occurs when these functions are invoked with bound JDBC parameters (PreparedStatement placeholders, e.g. `ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromGeoJSON(?), 4326)`), not literals, and through the specific composed forms (ST_SetSRID wrapping ST_GeomFromGeoJSON, ST_DWithin/ST_Within/ST_DistanceSphere as predicates, FindGeometryMetadata as a stored-procedure style call). New/updated test cases should exercise each of the eight listed functions via PreparedStatement bind parameters (matching the Micronaut Data code path) rather than only inline literals, then regenerate metadata with the native-image agent so it records the actual reflective call site.
risks: If agent-recorded metadata still differs based on argument literal-vs-bound-parameter resolution paths inside H2's function alias mechanism, coverage may need to include both forms per function to avoid re-missing the same class under a different call shape.
